name: rzcode_upload_images
description: Upload or update images for a RZCode project. Works for both cloud and local projects. Note: For local projects, prefer using scripts/upload_image_files.py to avoid loading images into LLM context.

items.description: Image file name with extension (must end with .png, .jpg, .jpeg, or .svg). Screenshot name limited to 20 chars, diagram name up to 120 chars.
Base64 encoded image content (must decode to < 4MB)
Optional metadata with 'type' ('screenshot' or 'diagram'), and for diagrams: 'diagram_type' and optional 'diagram_description'

image_extraction_task_id.description: For local-mode projects, the ID of the created image extraction task
